quest.title: The Purging of Evil
quest.description: Starsnatcher's ability to purge evil stems from the Sigil of Permission. After an unforeseen mishap, you give chase to a group of hilichurls with an evil aura...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x550, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

talks.objective: Use Elemental Sight to track down the hilichurls with the evil aura

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: It's you... I remember you.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I was purging some living beings that had been tainted by the demonic. It would appear that I have caused you some trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Huh? He isn't usually this polite, what's going on...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But you were exorcizing demons, how is that causing trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: That is because the changes that occurred in these monsters stem from me — or more precisely, from the karma I have accumulated.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mutations, karma... Does that mean...

choices.text: We read about that in the book...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. Paimon remembers that Xiao is also called the Vigilant Yaksha, isn't he?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... so that means... Aww...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sniff* P—Poor Xiao...

choices.text: We read about your past in a book.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I see. You must mean that piece of literati fan fiction from a few hundred years ago.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Hmph. All things are impermanent, and to exist is to suffer. We yakshas have no need of sympathy or tears.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: My comrades who have passed on would see your tears as a stain upon their legacy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, uh... Paimon's sorry...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: It matters not. In any case, I am on my way to purge a cavern of demonic influence, so we shall part ways here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Wait! Take us with you! We'll be a big help, Paimon promises!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: No need. I am used to fighting alone, and in any case these mutations originated from me to begin with...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well then... Oh! Consider it Paimon's penance for being accidentally rude just now! ...Please?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...Come on then.

choices.text: We were just reading a book called "Yakshas: The Guardian Adepti."
So Xiao is the final yaksha?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, this place gives Paimon goosebumps!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I will use the ritual known as the Bane of All Evil to relieve this place of its karma.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: You must remain calm. Do not allow yourself to be affected by the lingering wrath of bygone gods.

talks.objective: Clear the cavern of the hilichurls with the evil aura

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: It is good that we came here. An unusual number of living things had fallen under infernal influence. Had we not arrived in good time, the consequences would have been unthinkable.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Now. This "Starsnatcher" you speak of. What is the situation?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, Paimon'll tell you!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: An adeptus who grants wishes... To think that people could be so easily deceived by such blatant lies...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As an adeptus, do you have the power to grant wishes, Xiao?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: The Liyue of yesteryear would never ask the adepti for boons unearned.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Millennia ago, the ancestral people of Liyue asked for nothing more than the strength to defend the land they called their home.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ehh... To be honest, an adepti who grants people's wishes is probably more appealing to people nowadays...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: However feeble people nowadays may be, they are not my concern. I concern myself only with following Rex Lapis' original decree.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoops... Paimon spoke without thinking again...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, ah, one more thing! That fake adeptus has a Sigil of Permission. It's what he uses to exorcise demons!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Wait, truly? Hmph. Fool. Exorcizing demons without exterminating them — it is no wonder they have been congregating here.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: If this continues, things may spiral out of even my control... We must confiscate his Sigil of Permission.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great minds think alike! Paimon agrees, we've gotta show that trickster what you get for trying to fool us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And it just so happens that we've got a real adeptus with us too! If Xiao were to teach Starsnatcher a lesson, you can bet he'll never dare to pose as an adeptus ever again!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: No. I only slay demons — I do not kill mortals.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Who said anything about killing him!?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: It would certainly benefit Liyue if we could convince him to cease his wicked ways.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I possess an art called Dream Trawler. It is normally used to separate the soul from the body, that one might cultivate oneself in a waking dream...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: But it can also be used to call forth the spirits of others.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, now that's a real adepti art for ya!

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: A ritual must be performed for this art to be used. Assist me in gathering a few items... a censer, seven lamps, and something to reduce the temperature.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Reduce the temperature... Oh, some Mist Flowers will probably do, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But as for the censer and the seven lamps... Hmm... Probably not the kinds of things we're gonna just stumble across in the wild.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Do you know of the two yaksha statues that stand guard beside a merchant road on the southern face of Mt. Tianheng?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: The ancestors of the people of Liyue built shrines there to honor the yakshas. You should still be able to find some ceremonial items there.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Once you have found them, meet me at the yaksha statues after nightfall, and I will teach you how to use this art.

choices.text: You'll scare him out of his wits for sure.
I think I'd also like to teach him a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Male Believer
dialogues.text: It's not like the Master of Stars to fail an exorcism — perhaps he isn't feeling well today?

dialogues.speaker: Female Believer
dialogues.text: What happened there? Good thing we had you around, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Mercantile Believer
dialogues.text: I can't believe that the Master of Stars wasn't powerful enough to defeat those hilichurls...

dialogues.speaker: Starsnatcher
dialogues.text: One is merely feeling unwell. One hopes that you shall not spread these tidings wantonly...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Finish your preparations, and we shall enter — we should not leave those monsters be for too long.
